visual_review.material_identity: Worn rectangular stones in clear staggered horizontal courses, thin warm-earth joints and sparse olive moss; correct road-paving family.
visual_review.style: Low-contrast warm gray-brown, no heavy black grid, dark outer frame or center spotlight. Native stone faces contain noticeably more fine mottling/chipped edge detail than the requested broad-plane style and the other three candidates. This is a disclosed style risk, not an approved chunky-style pass.
visual_review.stone_scale: Visual estimate roughly5-7 main rectangular stones across most courses, below requested10-14. Around ten horizontal courses down the canvas; geometric layout remains readable.
visual_review.candidate128_world_effect: Large rectangles roughly18-28logical units wide and11-14high at full128source period; small native mottling compresses at that scale but must be judged in the full scene.
visual_review.coverage: Fully opaque edge-to-edge native material; no edits, texture repaint or seamlessness claim.
